# Beekeeper

> Beekeeper is a frontline success platform that connects deskless workers through mobile-first communication, task management, and AI-powered automation.

Beekeeper provides a unified employee app for frontline teams in retail, hospitality, manufacturing, and other shift-based industries. The platform integrates with existing HR, LMS, and payroll systems while emphasizing security, multilingual support, and ease of use for non-desk workers.

## Key Topics

- Frontline workers
- Employee engagement
- Internal communications
- Mobile-first
- Deskless workers
- Shift management
- Task management
- Workforce management
- GDPR compliance
- AI assistant (Maia)
- Integrations (HRIS, LMS, ADP)
- Onboarding
- Work automation
- Multilingual support
- Employee app
